title: The homepage got a text feed
summary:
Text became easier to explore, while model options, community projects, and the links around them got attention.

The homepage now switches between image and text feeds. The text feed pairs a stream of generated responses with an editor, while projects open on a Featured category with tabs for browsing.

Affiliate-link processing was added to regular and streamed chat completions, with no referral links by default. When enabled with `p-ads`, selection considers both the conversation and generated text; a streamed response can append a link at the end. Later adjustments made trigger matches probabilistic and reduced how often Ko-fi appears when no relevant offer is found.

`llamascout` was added through Cloudflare with a 4096-token output limit. The `mistral` and `qwen-qwq` mappings now use Cloudflare models, and the `deepseek-reasoning` listing identifies DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B rather than full DeepSeek R1.

Goalani, a voice-enabled AI fitness coach, and DominiSigns, which translates text and audio into Dominican Sign Language with a 3D avatar, were added to the project listings.
